comment: Machine readability of elements and relationships makes automated checking possible, but it does not by itself make an architecture testable. The document does not yet define machine-readable validation rules, mandatory properties, cardinalities, or acceptable relationship patterns.

anchor.note: p.79 l.Lines 970-980 read as the printed page; section 3.7.1 agrees

public.text: Machine readability of elements and relationships makes automated checking possible, but it does not by itself make an architecture testable. The document does not yet define machine-readable validation rules, mandatory properties, cardinalities, or acceptable relationship patterns.
public.suggestedRevision: Publish a formal architecture profile containing schemas, identifiers, permitted relationships, mandatory properties, validation rules, severity levels, and machine-readable test assertions.
